settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Stalingrad November 1942, ruined brick factories, shattered apartments, cold Volga wind, snow dust, smoke and rubble, Soviet Red Army soldier POV, non-graphic combat, no propaganda glamour, no modern objects, no game HUD. Prioritize tactile cold, ruined-building acoustics, fatigue and long stretches of tense waiting rather than constant gunfire.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman POV during the Stalingrad fighting as Operation Uranus begins and the German Sixth Army becomes encircled. One main action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration, no intelligible human speech. Do not make every scene active combat. Use a realistic rhythm of movement, listening, waiting, cold, exhaustion, gear handling and occasional distant violence. Several scenes should be almost quiet, letting wind, breathing, loose brick, fire crackle and room tone carry the experience.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person Stalingrad reenactment, cold blue-gray daylight, brick dust, smoke, practical winter uniforms, restrained handheld camera. Camera behaves like an exhausted body: cautious steps, balance corrections, brief stillness, visible breath and slow reactions to sound. Preserve frost, dust, soot and fatigue continuity.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP02 — Stalingrad: The Encirclement Begins
movie.storySummary: A fictional Soviet rifleman holds a shattered sector of Stalingrad in November 1942 while Operation Uranus begins outside the city. The episode remains close to the soldier's immediate experience and ends as the strategic situation shifts around the Axis army.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman in Stalingrad during 19–23 November 1942. Make the viewer feel freezing air in the lungs, brick dust in gloves, cramped basement passages, weak firelight, distant artillery rolling through walls and the mental strain of waiting. Do not use constant firefights. Let ruined rooms become quiet enough to hear breath, loose glass, pipes, fire crackle and snow against broken windows. Tell everything visually. No spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human sound is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion.

scenes.title: Cold Factory Dawn
scenes.description: POV wakes in a ruined factory position before dawn, body stiff from cold.
scenes.actionDescription: Gloved hands slowly lift a frost-cold Mosin-Nagant from a rubble-covered floor while breath clouds the view.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Soviet soldier POV inside a ruined brick factory in Stalingrad, pale frosted breath, rifle in worn gloves, brick dust on sleeves, broken windows rimmed with frost, dim dawn smoke and scattered machine debris.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow first-person rise from rubble to standing height with stiff movement. Audio foreground: breathing, coat fabric, rifle wood and metal. Mid-ground: wind whistling through broken windows, loose glass tick. Background: very distant artillery. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Ammunition Count
scenes.description: A deliberately quiet inventory scene; the soldier counts a small supply of ammunition with no nearby combat.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands count rifle clips one by one on a splintered crate, pausing after the last clip.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of worn Soviet rifle clips on a splintered wooden crate among red brick dust, winter sleeves and cracked gloves visible, candle stub nearby, cold blue light leaking through a broken wall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static POV. No gunfire nearby, no explosion, no music. Audio: individual metal clicks, glove leather, faint wind through masonry, slow breathing and one distant building creak. Let silence between sounds remain audible. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Across the Courtyard
scenes.description: The squad crosses a rubble-filled courtyard to the next building.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV runs once across an open courtyard into a broken doorway, boots slipping on loose brick and snow.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint across a shattered brick courtyard, snow patches between masonry, smoke hanging low, one squadmate reaching a doorway ahead, no graphic imagery.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single fast forward run ending inside doorway with a heavy stop. Audio: boots on brick, rubble rolling, equipment bounce, hard breathing and only scattered distant bursts. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Basement Passage
scenes.description: The soldier moves through a dark basement connecting positions.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows one comrade through a narrow basement opening, shoulder brushing damp brick and a hanging pipe.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Soviet soldier moving through a dark brick basement, weak candle stub, condensation on pipes, frost near a wall breach, rubble underfoot, winter gear filling the narrow frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward handheld movement through one low basement corridor. Audio foreground: boots, debris crunch, breath. Mid-ground: pipe creaks and occasional water drip. Background artillery is muffled heavily by walls. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Window Position
scenes.description: The POV reaches a firing position overlooking a ruined street but does not fire.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier raises the rifle to one broken window and silently scans the empty street without taking a shot.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle resting at shattered brick window overlooking an empty snow-dusted Stalingrad street, damaged buildings opposite, thin smoke drifting between facades, ice on window edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow horizontal scan through broken window. No firing by POV. Audio: cold wind, loose glass, distant rumble, breathing. Leave long gaps without loud effects. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Barrage Changes
scenes.description: Heavy artillery is heard far beyond the city sector.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV lowers the rifle and turns toward the distant horizon sound.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person inside ruined apartment, rifle lowered, pale horizon visible through wall breach, distant smoke columns outside city, brick fragments and plaster dust close to camera.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn from street window toward distant horizon. Audio: deep rolling artillery from far away rather than nearby impacts, cold wind through broken masonry, breath and fabric. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Runner Arrives
scenes.description: A breathless runner arrives from another sector as the distant offensive intensifies.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a snow-dusted runner entering the position and pointing toward the distant barrage.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of a snow-dusted Soviet runner arriving inside ruined factory, frost on shoulders, exhausted soldiers watching, broken machinery and dusty brick walls around them.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera turns once toward the runner as he arrives and gestures silently. Audio: hurried boots, breath, cloth, distant barrage. No spoken words. No narration.

scenes.title: Hold the Line
scenes.description: The unit quietly prepares to maintain its position.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands pull a winter glove tight and grip the rifle again while another soldier checks a wall opening.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person close view of worn winter glove tightening around rifle, brick barricade ahead, squadmates low behind cover, soot and frost on surfaces.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static close POV with one glove-tightening action. Audio: fabric, rifle metal, breathing, distant artillery with long quiet gaps. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Rubble Route
scenes.description: The soldier carries ammunition to another position through ruins.
scenes.actionDescription: POV carries one ammunition box across a broken interior passage, stepping carefully around unstable masonry.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands carrying a scratched ammunition box through shattered apartment interior, exposed beams, snow blowing through gaps, wallpaper remnants and brick dust visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward movement while carrying box. Audio: box rattle, rubble footsteps, wind entering through wall holes, breathing; distant combat remains background only. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Volga Wind
scenes.description: A quiet observation beat at a river-facing opening with the Volga visible through smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses without moving, one glove resting on cold masonry while watching smoke drift over the Volga.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view toward the cold Volga through ruined structures, frost on brick edge, pale winter light, smoke moving slowly above river, stacked supply crates under cover, gloved hand resting motionless in foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Almost static shot with only slight natural head sway. No nearby battle effects. Foreground: slow breath, glove rubbing gritty frozen brick. Mid-ground: strong river wind and loose canvas. Background: faint engines and very distant artillery. No music. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Night in the Ruins
scenes.description: A deep quiet recovery scene at night; the soldier warms numb hands while the ruined building settles around him.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV holds gloved hands near a tiny sheltered flame and does nothing else for several seconds.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloved hands near a tiny protected flame in dark ruined factory, soot-black brick, faint orange reflection on rifle metal, frost beyond the shelter, distant flashes barely visible through wall gap.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static low POV. No gunfire nearby, no explosion, no music. Audio foreground: tiny fire crackle, slow tired breathing, glove fabric. Mid-ground: wind moaning through high broken windows and one occasional brick settling sound. Background battlefield sound nearly disappears. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Ring Tightens
scenes.description: The next day the distant battlefield pressure is visibly increasing around the city.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks from a marked field map toward smoke on the horizon.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Soviet position in daylight, rough field map on crate, gloved finger tracing an encircling route, pencil marks, chipped enamel mug and ruined walls in winter light.
scenes.videoPrompt: One tilt from map toward the distant skyline. Audio: paper rustle, pencil tap, wind, breathing, far artillery. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Linkup Sign
scenes.description: A newly marked map indicates Soviet spearheads have linked west of Stalingrad.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV watches a gloved hand draw the final connection on a field map while exhausted soldiers silently react.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of a rough wartime map on a crate with a fresh pencil line completing an encirclement, exhausted Soviet soldiers nearby, restrained expressions, dim winter light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow tilt from map mark to nearby soldiers exchanging silent looks. Audio: pencil on paper, room tone, coat fabric, distant guns, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Still Fighting
scenes.description: The city battle continues despite the changing strategic situation.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV returns to the broken window position with rifle ready but waits rather than firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle at shattered Stalingrad window again, smoke and ruined street beyond, cold daylight, frost and brick dust on sill.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move back to the window position and hold. POV does not fire. Audio: wind, occasional distant combat, rifle settling on brick, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Winter Horizon
scenes.description: The episode ends in stillness looking over the devastated city as the battle enters a new phase.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV lowers the rifle slightly and remains still while looking across the winter ruins.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wide view across shattered Stalingrad under pale winter sky, layered smoke columns, Volga haze, snow dust moving along rooftops, no victory parade.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt from rifle to broad ruined skyline, then hold. Audio: cold wind, faint distant artillery, breathing and loose fabric. No music for the final seconds. No speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman
characters.description: Anonymous fictional composite soldier used as first-person viewer perspective; historically plausible 1942 Soviet winter uniform and rifle; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: Soviet winter field uniform, gloves, greatcoat elements, steel helmet where appropriate, Mosin-Nagant rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep gloves, sleeves, rifle and winter gear consistent. Frost, soot, brick dust and fatigue accumulate naturally across scenes and must not reset. Avoid clear facial depiction.

atmosphereAssets.title: Ruined Factory District
atmosphereAssets.description: Brick factory interiors with broken machinery, soot, shattered windows, frost, snow dust, weak fires, metal echoes and long periods of near silence between distant barrages.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: cold winter daylight / dim practical firelight at night

atmosphereAssets.title: Apartment Ruins
atmosphereAssets.description: Collapsed apartment blocks, narrow rubble corridors, icy broken windows, exposed pipes, loose glass and ruined street views with muffled battlefield acoustics indoors.

atmosphereAssets.title: Volga Riverbank Sector
atmosphereAssets.description: Cold river-facing ruins, frost-coated masonry, supply crates, strong wind and drifting smoke over the Volga; sparse sound and exposed winter atmosphere.
